# Support

- **Something is broken?** Open an [issue](https://github.com/yegor-pelykh/image-in-browser/issues). A minimal repro helps more than a long description.
- **A question or an idea?** Open an issue too, or [email me](mailto:yegor.dev@gmail.com).
- **Want to chip in?** [DONATE.md](https://github.com/yegor-pelykh/image-in-browser/blob/main/DONATE.md) has the addresses, QR codes, and the boring details.
